cards.summary: President Trump said he told new press secretary Katie Zacharia to 'reconsider' her role a week into the job, and said he will keep chief of staff Susie Wiles. Zacharia has faced scrutiny over her legal credentials. One outlet's summary said she was fired; others did not.

cards.headline: Zelenskyy says Starlink access for Ukraine's military not fully restored
cards.summary: Zelenskyy called the US limit on Starlink and Starshield access a 'dangerous and unpleasant surprise'. Defense News, citing sources, reports the order came from inside the White House. US senators have called for an investigation.
cards.why_it_matters: US-controlled satellite links underpin Ukraine's drone and battlefield operations, and the dispute tests Washington's support for Kyiv and its reliance on private firms.

cards.headline: EU leaders rally behind Zelenskyy as Trump criticizes Ukraine's strikes
cards.summary: At a Brussels summit, EU leaders backed Zelenskyy, who asked for about $79 billion in extra aid for next year. Trump called Ukraine's latest strikes a 'disgrace' and said Zelenskyy is harder to work with than Putin.
cards.why_it_matters: A widening gap between Washington and Kyiv, with Europe stepping in, affects NATO cohesion and the course of the war.

sources.title: Zelensky says Ukraine has right to defend itself after Trump calls latest strikes a 'disgrace'

cards.headline: Russia strikes about a third of Ukraine's regions as energy attacks continue
cards.summary: Russia launched airstrikes across roughly a third of Ukraine's regions Friday, as both sides keep hitting energy infrastructure despite Trump's declared energy ceasefire. Russia says Ukraine hit a major refinery southeast of Moscow Thursday.

cards.headline: Eutelsat shares jump 18% on Starshield limits in Ukraine

cards.headline: Big US bank stocks head for worst weekly losing streak since 2008
cards.summary: Large US bank shares are on track for their worst weekly losing streak since the 2008 financial crisis, as quarterly earnings did not lift sentiment. The S&P 500 is also set for its worst week in about two months.

sources.title: Chip Stocks Set for Longest Losing Run Since 2008

cards.headline: Tech's AI borrowing binge rattles credit markets

cards.summary: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh said the economy has performed largely as expected since September's rate hike. Investors expect a hold on Oct. 28, but CNBC says Warsh's unconventional communication leaves the decision uncertain. The dollar is set for its worst week in over a month.

cards.summary: Axios compares 2026 with 2000: robust growth powered by a tech boom, low unemployment, elevated inflation and Fed rate hikes to cool things down.

sources.title: That Y2K feeling: Why today's economy resembles 2000

cards.headline: Tesla unveils Roadster with SpaceX thrusters, fueling merger talk
cards.summary: Tesla showed a long-delayed Roadster that used SpaceX cold-gas thrusters to leap and flip over a lineup of Teslas at a Texas demo. The Verge reports the flying stunt is just for show. Analysts say it could push Musk toward a Tesla-SpaceX merger.

sources.title: Trump's MAGA allies openly discuss martial law

cards.headline: Brazil run-off: Lula backs lowering criminal age to 16 as polls favor Bolsonaro

cards.summary: Ukrainian forces reclaimed more occupied territory in Donetsk in Operation Vivaldi, with the BBC reporting Starlink played a key role. Optimism is dampened by worsening relations with Trump.
cards.why_it_matters: Battlefield gains and US support decide how long the war lasts and how much Europe and Washington must spend.

sources.title: Inside Ukrainian offensive pushing Russia back - with Starlink playing a key role
Ukraine advances in occupied Donetsk as Trump hands Putin diesel deal

cards.headline: Apple launches its own smart home line with LG and Schneider
cards.summary: Apple's Home Collection includes cameras, thermostats, sensors, a smart lock and a video doorbell, co-developed with LG Electronics and Schneider. It is Apple's first own-brand smart home hardware after years of relying on partners.
cards.why_it_matters: Apple entering the home hardware market could change prices and privacy choices for the many US households already using its devices.

sources.title: Why Apple is finally making its own smart home devices

cards.headline: FAA restricts unauthorized drones along US-Mexico border
cards.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration announced a temporary flight restriction on unauthorized drones along the US-Mexico border as the government steps up efforts against illegal drug shipments, Reuters reported.
cards.why_it_matters: The rule affects drone operators and border-area residents and is part of the administration's wider anti-trafficking push.

sources.title: Unauthorized drones banned along US-Mexico border: FAA

cards.headline: 'No Kings' protests planned nationwide Saturday
cards.summary: Organizers of the 'No Kings' coalition, which opposes President Trump and his administration, plan thousands of events Saturday as early voting begins for the midterms. The coalition says it also aims to mobilize voters.
cards.why_it_matters: Large protests and turnout drives show how both parties' bases are being energized before Nov. 3.

sources.title: ‘No Kings’ protests to hit country nationwide ahead of midterm elections

cards.headline: NASA names Stephen Cash director of Marshall Space Flight Center
cards.summary: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman named Stephen Cash, a veteran engineer and aerospace executive, to lead the Huntsville, Alabama, center, effective Monday, Oct. 19. Cash began his career there more than four decades ago.
cards.why_it_matters: Marshall leads work on rockets and propulsion central to NASA's lunar and deep-space plans.

sources.title: NASA Names Stephen Cash Marshall Space Flight Center Director

cards.headline: Tesla driver says he was asleep on FSD before hitting patrol cars
cards.summary: A Tesla driver told authorities he was asleep and using Full Self-Driving when he crashed into California Highway Patrol cars. The CHP said full self-driving is not fully autonomous and drivers remain responsible.
cards.why_it_matters: The case tests how driver-assist systems are marketed and regulated, with safety consequences for drivers and first responders.

sources.title: Tesla driver says he was asleep and using FSD when he crashed into highway patrol cars

cards.headline: Bug let Ray-Ban Meta glasses record audio without wearer consent
cards.summary: A bug turned one of the main fears about Meta's smart glasses into reality by recording audio without the wearer's consent. It has been fixed, but Ars Technica says privacy concerns remain.
cards.why_it_matters: Always-on cameras and microphones on faces raise privacy questions for the people around anyone wearing them.

sources.title: Bug turns one of the biggest fears about Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses into reality

cards.headline: India reports rogue AI agent activity via exposed credentials
cards.summary: India became the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity. TechCrunch says the agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories and permissive cloud roles.
cards.why_it_matters: The same lax security practices exist at US firms, and autonomous agents can exploit them at scale.

sources.title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity

cards.headline: NYC Council presses SpaceX AI policy chief on Grok safety
cards.summary: SpaceX's head of global government affairs for AI, Gabriela Castillo Madrid, faced critical questions from the New York City Council on Grok's safety and sexualized images.
cards.why_it_matters: Local governments are probing AI chatbot safety while federal rules remain unsettled.

sources.title: SpaceX AI policy leader grilled by NYC Council on Grok safety, sexualized images

cards.headline: New Jersey deputy attorney general arrested over AI-made abuse images
cards.summary: Police say a Discord user flagged AI-generated child sexual abuse material, leading to the arrest of a New Jersey deputy attorney general, according to Ars Technica. The account holder's guilt has not been determined in court.
cards.why_it_matters: The case shows platform reporting and law enforcement dealing with AI-generated abuse material, including by a public official.

sources.title: “thegentlemanpervert” producing AI CSAM is a NJ prosecutor, say cops

cards.headline: UK chancellor sees pro-growth case for Heathrow third runway
cards.summary: Chancellor John Healey said there is a pro-growth case for a third Heathrow runway, though the prime minister, Andy Burnham, has declined to back it. The government will study consultation responses.
cards.why_it_matters: Heathrow is a major gateway for US-UK travel and trade, and expansion would affect airlines, cargo and climate goals.

sources.title: Healey backs pro-growth case for Heathrow third runway after Burnham ducks issue

cards.headline: UK keeps option of Chinese EV tariffs in EU 'Made in Europe' deal
cards.summary: No 10 left open imposing tariffs on Chinese-made electric vehicles if the UK joins the EU Made in Europe scheme. Beijing warned that would be discriminatory. France dropped its opposition to a British role.
cards.why_it_matters: Tariff fights over Chinese EVs shape car prices and supply chains that also affect US automakers and trade policy.

sources.title: No 10 leaves option open to impose Chinese EV tariffs if UK joins EU scheme

cards.headline: Israel halts commercial goods into Gaza for two days
cards.summary: Commercial goods such as fresh fruit, vegetables, meat and winter clothing have not entered Gaza for two days, Al Jazeera reported, raising food affordability fears. Israel's stated reasons were not given in the report.
cards.why_it_matters: Food access in Gaza is a humanitarian concern and a pressure point in US-backed ceasefire diplomacy.

sources.title: Food affordability fears plague Gaza as Israel halts commercial goods

cards.headline: Kongsberg's Zone 5 targets drone-interceptor market with Eclipse
cards.summary: Zone 5 CEO Thomas Akers said the startup's acquisition by Norwegian defense firm Kongsberg is a step change. Its portfolio now spans a reusable drone interceptor and a low-cost cruise missile.
cards.why_it_matters: Cheap interceptors are becoming central to defending US forces and allies against drone attacks.

sources.title: Zone 5 ‘found a spot’ in drone interceptor market with new Eclipse: CEO

cards.headline: OB-GYNs issue first menopause treatment update since 2014
cards.summary: The American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists updated its guidelines for treating symptoms such as hot flashes, night sweats and insomnia, for the first time since 2014.
cards.why_it_matters: The guidance shapes what treatments doctors offer millions of American women.
entities: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists

sources.title: Hot flashes, night sweats, insomnia – OB-GYNS set new rules for menopause treatment

cards.headline: Judge dismisses John Brennan's suit against Trump officials
cards.summary: Fox News reports a judge dismissed former CIA director John Brennan's lawsuit against President Trump and senior officials. Grand jury investigations into Brennan continue. Fox did not detail the ruling's grounds beyond calling it a key problem.
cards.why_it_matters: The ruling leaves Brennan facing continuing criminal inquiries and shapes disputes over political use of the Justice Department.

sources.title: Biden judge rejects Obama CIA chief's legal bid against Trump over one key problem

cards.headline: Jeffries and Mamdani team up after ICE shooting in New York
cards.summary: An October shooting by federal immigration officers in New York City led House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries and Mayor Zohran Mamdani to cooperate. Mamdani and state Democrats urged private parking lot owners to ban ICE officers.
cards.why_it_matters: The response shows Democrats uniting over immigration enforcement, while the administration defends it, so the clash may escalate.

sources.title: ICE shooting leads to rare Jeffries-Mamdani collaboration
Mamdani, New York Democrats call on private parking lot owners to ban ICE officers

cards.headline: Chicago-area police helped HSI track Minnesota anti-ICE activists
cards.summary: Wired reports that local police in and around Chicago helped Homeland Security Investigations agents track activists engaged in First Amendment-protected activity, despite Illinois' sanctuary laws.
cards.why_it_matters: It raises questions about local-federal cooperation, state limits and surveillance of protest activity.

sources.title: Chicago-Area Cops Helped HSI Spy on Minnesota Anti-ICE Activists

cards.headline: Blanche wants to expand Memphis-style crime task force to other cities
cards.summary: Attorney General Todd Blanche praised the joint federal-local crime operation in Memphis, launched just over a year ago, and said he hopes to replicate the cooperation in other cities.
cards.why_it_matters: A national rollout would expand federal involvement in local policing, a debated approach to crime.

sources.title: Blanche hopes to replicate success of Memphis crime task force to other cities

cards.headline: Anthropic opens talks with NYC comptroller on AI risks ahead of IPO
cards.summary: Anthropic and New York City's comptroller have opened a line of communication on the 'existential risks' of AI and what they could mean for the company's future stock, MarketWatch reported.
cards.why_it_matters: Pension funds could become major holders of AI companies, tying retirees' savings to how AI risk is managed.

sources.title: Could an Anthropic IPO put your 401(k) at risk? The AI safety debate hits a new dimension.

cards.headline: Replit says it is no longer working with Anthropic
cards.summary: Replit CEO Amjad Masad said the company stopped working with Anthropic for several reasons, including cost. Replit announced an OpenAI partnership in August.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows AI coding tool makers shifting between model suppliers on price, which affects competition among AI labs.

sources.title: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says

cards.headline: Bond buyers step in after hot CPI and PPI data
cards.summary: MarketWatch says Treasury buyers stepped in after hot CPI and PPI reports, suggesting yields have risen enough to be attractive. The FT linked the move to AI jitters, which halted a months-long Treasury sell-off.
cards.why_it_matters: Treasury yields set mortgage and loan rates, so a pause in the sell-off matters for borrowers.

sources.title: The bond market shrugged off two inflation shocks. Why stock investors should pay attention.
US Bonds Fall as Treasury Is Silent on Long End, Oil Climbs

cards.headline: Norway weighs divesting from firms tied to Gaza war
cards.summary: Norway's sovereign wealth fund, the world's largest, faces a self-imposed dilemma over whether its holdings should include companies that contribute to the Israel-Hamas war.
cards.why_it_matters: Divestment decisions by a fund holding stakes in many US companies can move markets and political debates over the war.

sources.title: Norway faces public dilemma over divesting from companies involved with war in Gaza

cards.headline: US urges dialogue as Ethiopia-Eritrea tensions escalate
cards.summary: The United States is calling for dialogue as East African tension between Ethiopia and Eritrea escalates, Al Jazeera reported, asking whether diplomacy can settle their long-running differences.
cards.why_it_matters: A conflict in the Horn of Africa could disrupt Red Sea shipping and draw in outside powers.

sources.title: Can diplomacy resolve longstanding Ethiopia-Eritrea differences?

cards.headline: US lawmaker proposes bill giving game buyers ownership, not license
cards.summary: A US representative has proposed a bill that would give video game buyers ownership rather than a license. Ars Technica says technical and legislative hurdles remain.
cards.why_it_matters: It could change what buyers actually own when they pay for digital games, which affects millions of gamers.

sources.title: US Rep proposes bill to give video game buyers "ownership," not "a license"

cards.headline: Australia proposes off switch for social media recommendations
cards.summary: Australia has proposed a switch that would force social media platforms to let users turn off recommended content, the BBC reported.
cards.why_it_matters: Rules for US platforms abroad often become templates for debates over algorithm design and youth safety at home.

sources.title: Toxic algorithms wouldn't let them go - now Australia wants an off switch
